name: Validate
goal: Settle the legal ground, the name and the license before building the product.
gate: Provider terms of use are verified and the integration decision is documented
Project name and license are decided

name: MVP desktop
goal: On a personal PC, a Wails desktop app over a background daemon that runs employees as independent official CLI sessions (Claude Code, Codex CLI) with several subscription profiles.
gate: Every F1-F6, F16, F17, S1-S3 and N1-N4, N6-N8 requirement is covered by passing tests
The daemon builds for linux/amd64, linux/arm64, darwin/amd64, darwin/arm64 and windows/amd64 without cgo
The desktop app builds natively on Windows, macOS and Linux in CI
docs/BENCHMARKS.md records measured values for every performance budget
A new user can go from download to a working employee following docs/QUICKSTART.md

name: Remote access
goal: The same daemon runs on a VPS and the desktop app connects to it over Tailscale (tsnet) with Tailscale identity.

name: Collaborate
goal: Employees hand work to each other, run on schedules and triggers, browse safely, share signed skills and run in OS-level sandboxes.

name: Learn
goal: Employees learn workflows from recordings; users see costs and get notifications.

name: Teams
goal: Several users share employees and memory on one daemon.
